Package com.example.eventlotteryapp.models

Class Entrant

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlotteryapp.models.Entrant
public class Entrant extends Object
Represents one user's relationship to one event in the lottery system. Entrant documents are stored at events/{eventId}/entrants/{deviceId} in Firestore. The eventId field is not persisted to Firestore; it is populated locally after a query.

  • Constructor Details

    • Entrant

      public Entrant()
      Required empty constructor for Firestore deserialization.

    • Entrant

      public Entrant(String deviceId, String eventId, String status, com.google.firebase.Timestamp joinedAt, com.google.firebase.Timestamp statusUpdatedAt)
      Creates a fully initialised Entrant.
      Parameters:
      deviceId - the entrant's device ID
      eventId - the event this entrant belongs to (local only, not stored in Firestore)
      status - the entrant's current status (use one of the STATUS_* constants)
      joinedAt - the timestamp when the user joined the waitlist
      statusUpdatedAt - the timestamp when the status was last changed

  • Method Details

    • getDeviceId

      public String getDeviceId()
      Returns the device ID of the user who joined this event's waitlist. Matches the Firestore document ID under users/ and the subcollection document ID.
      Returns:
      the entrant's device ID string

    • getEventId

      public String getEventId()
      Returns the event ID this entrant is associated with. This field is not stored in the Firestore document — it is set locally after querying the entrant from a subcollection.
      Returns:
      the event ID string, populated locally after a Firestore query

    • getStatus

      public String getStatus()
      Returns the entrant's current status in the event lottery lifecycle. Use the STATUS_* constants to compare against known values (e.g. STATUS_WAITLIST, STATUS_INVITED, STATUS_ENROLLED).
      Returns:
      the status string representing the entrant's current state

    • getJoinedAt

      public com.google.firebase.Timestamp getJoinedAt()
      Returns the timestamp when the user first joined the waitlist for this event.
      Returns:
      the Timestamp of when the entrant joined, or null if not set

    • getStatusUpdatedAt

      public com.google.firebase.Timestamp getStatusUpdatedAt()
      Returns the timestamp when the entrant's status was last updated. Updated whenever the status changes (e.g. from waitlist to invited).
      Returns:
      the Timestamp of the most recent status change, or null if not set

    • setDeviceId

      public void setDeviceId(String deviceId)
      Sets the device ID for this entrant. Should match the Firestore subcollection document ID and the user's ANDROID_ID.
      Parameters:
      deviceId - the entrant's device ID string

    • setEventId

      public void setEventId(String eventId)
      Sets the event ID this entrant is associated with. This field is local only — it is not written to the Firestore document. Use it to track which event an entrant belongs to after a collection group query.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the event ID string

    • setStatus

      public void setStatus(String status)
      Updates the entrant's current status in the lottery lifecycle. Use one of the STATUS_* constants (e.g. STATUS_INVITED).
      Parameters:
      status - the new status string

    • setJoinedAt

      public void setJoinedAt(com.google.firebase.Timestamp joinedAt)
      Sets the timestamp for when this entrant joined the waitlist. Typically set once when the entrant document is first created.
      Parameters:
      joinedAt - the Timestamp of when the user joined

    • setStatusUpdatedAt

      public void setStatusUpdatedAt(com.google.firebase.Timestamp statusUpdatedAt)
      Sets the timestamp for when the entrant's status was last updated. Should be updated every time the status field changes.
      Parameters:
      statusUpdatedAt - the Timestamp of the most recent status change
